evidence: The local arXiv source tar lists TeX and figure PDFs, but no CSV/TSV/DAT/FITS/VOTable-style source-native table for Sigma_star(R) or Sigma_gas(R).

The TeX source separately describes the Figure mass-surface-density profiles, the measured-color/constant-color variants, the approximately 3:1 outer stellar/gas ratio, and the total stellar mass beyond about 30 kpc.

The available source package does not specify a machine-readable mapping from the displayed profile curves to the isolated outer-disk integrated mass. The digitized profile therefore cannot be normalized into a load-bearing formula.
